zh.text: @robin_j_brooks 表示在2026年早前幾次充滿爭議的聯儲局會議後，本週會議幾乎未受市場關注，市場只反映12%加息機率，遠低於7月市場試圖迫使沃什加息時的水平：對沃什而言是暫時喘息。

en.text: @robin_j_brooks says after contentious Fed meetings earlier in 2026, this week's meeting draws little interest, with markets pricing only 12% odds of a hike, far less than in July when markets tried to push Warsh to hike: a temporary reprieve for Warsh.

zh.text: 可負擔性 = 特朗普的阿喀琉斯之踵。
@KobeissiLetter：2026年裁員公告包括UPS及Oracle各3萬人、Amazon 1.6萬人、Omnicom 1.5萬人及Meta 8000人；科技業已有330家公司裁員13.5萬人，企業在物價上升及AI普及下削減開支。

en.text: @KobeissiLetter: 2026 layoff announcements include UPS and Oracle at 30,000 each, Amazon 16,000, Omnicom 15,000 and Meta 8,000, and tech has seen 135,000 layoffs across 330 companies as firms cut costs amid rising prices and AI adoption.

zh.text: 如果你想深入瞭解第一個框架，《The Everything Code》將於下週二出版。債務、人口統計以及為什麼一切感覺如此昂貴，都集中在一處。

en.text: If you want to go deeper on the first framework, The Everything Code is out next Tuesday. Debt, demographics and why everything feels so expensive, all in one place.

zh.text: 大多數債券ETF是靜態的。它們無論市場狀況如何都持有相同敞口。$JOJO在高收益和長存續期國債之間輪換。一個代號兼具進攻與防守。

en.text: Most bond ETFs are static. They hold the same exposure regardless of market conditions. $JOJO rotates between high yield and long-duration Treasuries. Offense and defense in one ticker.

zh.text: @mhmd7sn 表示埃及鎊兌美元下跌會傷害民眾，但對經濟而言是最佳方案。固定匯率會消耗央行本應用於燃料和糧食的美元儲備；價格會上升、市場會波動但不會崩潰，相比之下2022至2023年的做法導致短缺和黑市。

en.text: @mhmd7sn says the Egyptian pound falling against the dollar hurts people but is the best solution for the economy. Fixing the rate burns central bank dollar reserves needed for fuel and food; prices will rise and markets wobble but not collapse, versus shortages and a black market as in 2022 to 2023.

zh.text: 加拿大重質原油在太平洋彼岸獲得接近紀錄的溢價，加強了該國計劃建造通往西海岸新管道的論點。

en.text: Canadian heavy crude is fetching near-record premiums across the Pacific, bolstering the case for the country’s plan to build a new pipeline to its west coast.

zh.text: 10月26日交易計劃。本週有FOMC、科技股財報、GDP+PCE。預計週四前有更大波動。$SPX可能至7500或回至7750-7800。$QQQ至685或727。今日跳空高開，$MU近900，$SNDK升25，$AMD從501近522。若守住可在FOMC前反彈。過去三次Warsh的FOMC當日拋售。觀察$SMH能否守525，$NBIS守145，$TSLA能否突破383。

en.text: TRADE PLAN for Oct 26th. Massive week with FOMC, Tech earnings, GDP + PCE. Expect bigger move by Thursday. $SPX either 7500 or 7750-7800. $QQQ to 685 or 727. Gap up today, $MU near 900, $SNDK up 25, $AMD near 522 from 501. If hold, rally into FOMC. Last 3 FOMC with Warsh saw selloff same day. Watch $SMH hold 525, $NBIS defend 145, $TSLA breakout above 383.

zh.text: 全球市場混合，進入財報高峯及FOMC/ECB/BOJ前的忙碌一週。油價較低，但AI/半導體/科技損失持續累積。$SPX期貨+16，觀察此區間是否守住，7612為關鍵活躍支撐。（引用：Scott Redler的#630club - 實時盤前股市更新 ➡️ $NVDA $MU $SPCX $SNDK）

en.text: Mixed markets around the world heading into a very busy week with peak earnings and the FOMC/ECB/BOJ ahead. Oil is lower, but AI/Semi/Tech damage continues to add up. $SPX futures are +16 ,  watching to see if this range holds, with 7612 as key active support. (Quoted: Scott Redler’s #630club - LIVE Premarket Stock Market Update ➡️ $NVDA $MU $SPCX $SNDK)
